title: Gated models: license-verified install for non-commercial weights (Klein 9B first)
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-528 - The licensing surface (consolidation sweep 2026-08-10). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-528/plan.md.

Some models we want are open-weights but non-commercial (FLUX.2 Klein 9B, Flux.1 Fill dev). Add a verification gate: user accepts the licence at the source (Hugging Face), we PROVE acceptance via an authenticated probe, then unlock the download from our own R2. Unblocks a whole class of models we currently refuse. AUDITED 2026-08-09 (/mpi-project-refresh claim audit): HALF OF THIS SHIPPED as MPI-451. The descriptor-driven per-model licence gate exists and survives a restart - js/data/modelConstants/licences.js (MODEL_LICENCES, getModelLicence, hasAcceptedLicence, recordLicenceAcceptance) plus js/components/Compounds/MpiLicenceGate/. It is wired for TWO ids today, both MiniMax H3. What this card still owns is the OTHER half, which MPI-451 did not build: PROVING acceptance at the source with an authenticated Hugging Face probe before unlocking our own R2 copy. Klein 9B / Flux.1 Fill dev need that probe, not another consent dialog. Re-scope the body before picking it up.
acceptance: Dep/ModelDef carries gated metadata: licenceUrl, source repo id, attribution notice text
Model Library tile shows a 'Licence verification required' badge instead of a normal Install button
Sidebar verification button runs the flow: open the licence page, user accepts, user supplies an HF access token
Acceptance is PROVEN server-side (authenticated probe of the gated repo returns 200 vs 403) - never a self-declared checkbox
Verified state persists per model with a timestamp; a revoked or expired token surfaces a clear re-verify prompt, not a silent 403
After verification the download comes from our R2 as usual - local AND Pod paths unchanged
The licence copy and Attribution Notice ship alongside the weights, per FLUX NCL v2.1 section 3 (redistribution conditions)
First consumer wired and installed end-to-end: FLUX.2 Klein 9B
